physical_readout_projective_synthesis.scope: Each of the four canonical root observables now has an exact spectral population protocol. Every target embeds in SU(29), and the existing exact strong-regularity theorem closes finite piecewise-control existence on the same frozen K_ij=0 fixture. One of four explicit 1 ps amplitude-bounded canonical pulses passes. The four phase-quotiented weighted-observable searches replay at 0.78 to 1.74 percent error but do not pass the strict precision tier. The canonical five-rung bath ladder remains historically open, while the predeclared D3,K1 higher-corner follow-up closes and rejects the tested canonical waveform. The weighted target-0 waveform is also rejected convergence-controlled on its declared five-rung 300 K K_ij=0 ladder. Two independently replayed direct D1,K0 bath-aware local searches fail the 0.1 operator tier; this is search-incomplete evidence, not a controllability no-go. The separate normalized 300 fs 12-segment continuation also returns far outside that gate at relative operator residual 0.997588; its predeclared exit clause therefore forbids the 24-segment and depth refinements for that control family. Convex recombination of seven, eight, nine, and all 29 terminal-population effects also fails the 0.1 residual and coefficient-amplification gates for the certified 300 fs pulse. These are terminal-sector diagnostics, not GSB/SE/ESA pathways. A separately typed 162-effect finite-probe heterodyne family spans the complete 49-dimensional Hermitian single-root algebra at D1,K0 and reproduces all four targets to numerical precision without a coefficient bound. Its retained condition number is about 4011, and every target fails when the normalized detector-combination L2 norm is capped at 10. This closes the molecular-frame root-effect tensor while leaving a stable calibrated readout open. It carries SE and signed ESA; GSB is absent because the ground input coordinate is not included. Expanding from three to all seven carrier frequencies improves the condition number from about 4011 to 936 and moves the unchanged bounded gate from zero of four to three of four targets. The subsequent predeclared standalone temporal-profile screen selects the 100 fs broad probe. Its independently replayed 882-effect tensor has full rank 49, condition number about 410, and passes all four bounded targets with coefficient norms 5.74 to 8.50 and residuals near 1e-14. The early profile is explicitly rejected by its forward/adjoint integrity gate; the late profile fails target 3, while the delayed-detector profile also passes target 3. Effects are never pooled across profiles. This closes bounded four-target readout only at the exploratory molecular-frame D1,K0 tier, not phase replication or an HEOM convergence ladder. The locked D1,K1 bath-expansion comparison passes, but D1,K0 to D2,K0 fails the depth comparison and D2,K0 to D3,K0 remains depth-unstable. All four bounded D3 rows fail, although the unbounded numerical span remains complete. This is valid negative finite-depth evidence, not an infinite-HEOM no-go. The source-locked tail diagnostic finds contraction in all 882 matched increments and authorizes exactly one costed D4,K0 classification rung. That forecast is not a convergence certificate, D4 is not yet executed, and no blind D5 escalation is authorized. Physical K_ij, absolute calibration, and laboratory detection remain open.
